The '''combat speeder''' was a model of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following Grievous' belief in authority and lethality, the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] featured a powerful turbine [[Engine/Legends|engine]], a pair of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and recessed [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]] in the forward prow. The craft was steered by a simple column connected to the directional vanes.

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DS1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used [[Gender/Legends|his]] speeder in his [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|campaign]] to conquer the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]],<ref name="SWE entry" /> where he used it to chase [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], his remaining [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Younglings]] in order to prevent them from retreating Florrum.<ref name="ANB" />
